title: Oven Roasted Silky Dutch Cauliflower Roast
description: A low-glycemic, caramelized cauliflower roast with a silky sauce infused with Thai bird chilies, perfect for a comforting dinner.
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°C and line a sheet pan with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, toss cauliflower florets with olive oil, smoked paprika, cumin, cinnamon, cayenne, and a pinch of salt until well coated.
Spread the florets in a single layer on the prepared sheet pan and roast for 25 minutes, turning halfway, until caramelized and golden.
While cauliflower roasts, combine tamari, maple syrup, lime juice, sliced Thai bird chilies, and coconut milk in a small saucepan over low heat; stir until lightly simmering.
Reduce heat to low and let the sauce thicken for 5 minutes, whisking occasionally, then remove from heat.
When cauliflower is done, drizzle the silky sauce over the florets and gently toss to coat.
Return the pan to the oven for an additional 5 minutes to meld flavors.
Remove from oven and let rest for 3 minutes.
Sprinkle fresh chopped cilantro or parsley if desired, and serve hot.
Garnish with a lime wedge for extra brightness.
